nativeVerification.Affix.GetWeighting: RVA 0x11B2D00: first matching equipment override weighting; otherwise base weighting
nativeVerification.Affix.HasShard: RVA 0x11B3CC0: Equipment and Standard/Set; excludes canRollOn == [IDOL_ALTAR]
nativeVerification.UniqueList.Entry.getLevelRequirement: RVA 0x125AB30: override value or ItemList.GetItemLevelRequirement(baseType, subtype), clamped to byte
nativeVerification.UniqueList.Entry.CanDropAtLevel: RVA 0x1259BC0: customDropLevel if enabled; otherwise any eligible subtype level requirement
nativeVerification.UniqueList.Entry.hasLevelRequirementAtOr: RVA 0x125ADF0: override level or any subtype level at/below requested level
nativeVerification.UniqueList.rollUnique: RVA 0x1270F10: builds an eligible candidate list, selects a candidate, reads rerollChance at 0x1271370, and calls RngElement.Roll at 0x12713F2. A successful roll rejects the candidate: failOnReroll returns failure; otherwise it resamples. After 60 rejections the last resampled candidate is returned without another rejection check. Optional weight compression can replace the raw reroll chance.
nativeVerification.RngElement.Roll: RVA 0xF6A6D0: compares chance with a 0..1 pseudorandom float; chance <= 0 returns false and chance >= 1 returns true. The 1.0 float constant was checked in the binary.
nativeVerification.UniqueList.ApplyUniqueWeightCompression: RVA 0x126E1A0; equivalent conditional compression logic is inlined in rollUnique at 0x1271394..0x12713D9. It depends on ItemRollModifiers and failOnReroll. No compressed probability formula is modeled by this extractor.

interpretation.rawFields: Original field names and numeric values are retained, apart from the display name fallback and tierCount summary.
interpretation.affixWeighting: Relative selection weight within an eligible pool. Use per-equipment weighting. Values can exceed 1; not a probability.
interpretation.specificRerollChance: Preserved legacy-named raw field; verified GetWeighting uses weighting, not rerollChance. Duplicate overrides use the first occurrence.
interpretation.ordinaryDropAffix: Matches the native IsDroppable property only. Special sources can produce Experimental, Personal, Set, etc.; false does not mean unobtainable.
interpretation.uniqueRerollChance: Raw candidate rejection/reroll input in the verified rollUnique path. With no weight compression and after a candidate has already been selected, 0.98 means approximately 98% rejection and 2% acceptance in that one check. Higher values reject more often under the same candidate environment. Rejection either fails the operation (failOnReroll) or selects another candidate; the latter path caps rejection checks at 60 and returns the last resampled candidate. Candidate eligibility, optional weight compression, callers and this cap prevent treating 1-rerollChance as a global or exact final-pool probability. In particular, 0.98 does not mean a 2% monster/boss/run drop chance. No global probability, unique rarity tier, or market value is assigned.
interpretation.nonRandomUnique: canDropRandomly=false identifies absence from the random-drop pool; it does not identify the boss, quest, craft, vendor or other acquisition source.
interpretation.lpLevel: Resolved per subtype with the verified override/fallback. Separate from unique drop rarity and actual LP count; also used by Weaver's Will. No LP probability or LP eligibility is inferred here.
interpretation.minimumLevelForEntryCanDropAtLevel: Only the UniqueList.Entry level gate, not a complete area/boss/faction/difficulty drop condition.
interpretation.tierCount: Count of serialized tier definitions, not a declaration that every tier drops naturally or can be forged.
interpretation.names: name preserves the original English research label. localizedName contains official game zh/en strings joined by ID; affixes prefer the enabled filter override then display name. Numeric value placeholders and rich-text tags are removed. Missing Chinese is null and must fall back visibly to English, never an invented translation.

coverage.dropSources: not extracted: boss/quest/vendor/encounter tables, per-source chances, difficulty/corruption requirements
coverage.probabilities: not calculated: global drops, affix tier drops, joint affix combinations, LP/WW distributions
